title: 1600WP item 5: the PRIMARY TIN branch code prints four compartments, BIR's own runtime declares five

subject.description: The fourth (branch-code) group of the item-5 TIN comb chain on page 1 -- the PRIMARY withholding agent's TIN, captioned 'TIN' at x 34.68-47.70. The chain prints 53.04-94.08 / 109.08-149.28 / 164.28-204.36 / 218.52-276.00, separated by three grey-filled, black-stroked spacer boxes 15.00 / 15.00 / 14.16pt wide (gray 0.7529, stroke 0.75pt) rather than by dashes. The whole row sits on a page-wide 0.7529 grey band (18.00,101.91-594.12,276.89). NOT the subject: the second page-1 TIN comb, emitted as p1c74, printed box 366.48-401.28 x 465.96-479.76 with its own three 0.25pt ticks at 375.79 / 384.61 / 393.44 -- a disjoint box 309pt lower on the sheet, owned by record C06. After the 2026-08-17 sitting the whole chain (not only this box) is reflowed to even 3-3-3-5 inside the original outer span; this printed box remains the PDF identity of the branch group.

reason: BIR's January-2010 artwork for 1600WP is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. It prints four compartments for the item-5 TIN branch code and pre-prints nothing in them. BIR's own eBIRForms client, whose runtime this repository has harvested, declares that same field with max_length 5. No rule can derive 'BIR widened this field after 2010' from 2010 ink, which is precisely why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug (ARCHITECTURE.md, 'What belongs in which stage'). Note what is NOT claimed: the stage-1 producer is not wrong here. It read four printed compartments and emitted four, and finding F178 was closed by doing exactly that; this record overrides a correct reading of an out-of-date sheet.

filing_safety.harm: The return is filed against the wrong branch. A TIN's branch code identifies the establishment a withholding return belongs to; if the fifth digit cannot be entered, the return either carries a truncated four-digit code or lands on a branch that is not the one that withheld the tax, and the establishment that did withhold it files nothing. 1600WP is a remittance return for taxes the agent has already withheld from someone else's money, so the mis-filing is of tax already collected.
filing_safety.who_is_affected: Every 1600WP filer whose withholding-agent branch code is five digits. They have no way to enter it on today's form at all. Filers with four-digit codes are unaffected today, which is why this form's defect is narrower than 2550M's.
filing_safety.today: Four compartments, nothing pre-printed, all four typeable: the filer can enter up to four digits and can enter nothing longer.
filing_safety.after: Five compartments over the same printed box; a five-digit branch code becomes enterable, and the emitted value can carry the five characters BIR's own client accepts for frm1600WP:txtBranchCode. The cost, stated rather than hidden: three of the five compartments no longer line up with the printed ticks, so a printed divider runs through them (see divergence).
